title: The Empty Seat by the Aisle
story: Sami checked his ticket at the station gate. His coach left at noon for the coast. He climbed on early and chose a seat by the aisle. A woman with a red suitcase stopped beside him. Her ticket showed the same number. Sami looked again and saw he was in the wrong row. He apologised and moved two seats back. The woman smiled and lifted her bag. During the ride Sami watched fields and small towns. He bought water at the rest stop. When the coach reached the coast, he thanked the driver. The mix-up had been easy to fix. He walked to the harbour feeling calm.
